| # ADC test voltage monitoring {#adc-test-voltage-monitoring-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                            |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This function monitors the analog−digital converter (ADC) of the microcontroller. The signals are read through an AD converter.

The following monitoring tests are performed:

 

- Test Voltage (amplification fault) - (signal VDD5_MON)

The ADC−testvoltage−check reads a fixed testvoltage and checks the converted value for valid values. By this check particularly reference faults and amplification faults of the ADC are detected.

 

- Null−load Test Pulse (value and update check)

The NTP test is done cyclically at the ADC input signal are connected. The switching of the ADC channel to ground internally and checked ADC value read.

 

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error reaction for Test Voltage:

- Over Voltage Error (VDD5_MON \>= Over Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ ----------------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_moOV_FirstConstADC
  Error Code                     0x082C00
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  200ms

 

- Under Voltage Error (VDD5_MON \<= Under Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ ----------------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_moUV_FirstConstADC
  Error Code                     0x082D00
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  200ms

 

Error reaction for Null load Pulse Test:

  Error                          Reaction
  ------------------------------ ------------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_adcPDD_fail
  Error Code                     0x083000
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      No
  Reaction time                  160 ms
